summary: Bally's Corp disclosed via 8-K that its majority-owned Greek subsidiary, Bally's Intralot (59.44% owned), has entered into a Cooperation Agreement to acquire Evoke PLC via a recommended all-share scheme of arrangement under Gibraltar law. Evoke shareholders will receive 0.537 new Bally's Intralot shares per Evoke share, valued at ~52 pence/share (based on a 1.12 share price), implying ~£243.1M equity value. A cash alternative capped at £117.1M is available, funded by a €200M bridge facility. Approvals required include Evoke and Bally's Intralot shareholder votes, gaming, antitrust, and FDI clearances. Watch for shareholder approval votes and regulatory calendar to set deal timing.
